ONE requested asset or ONE character view only, no contact sheet, no collage, no grid, no extra panels, no captions, no watermark. Keep full requested silhouette inside frame with white margins. Pixel M is a blocky geometric white emblem on a warm orange-red square, NOT a serif letter, not a cat face, not a random rune. No invented accessories, no extra tails or ears. For detached items draw only the requested item, no head, no human skin, no mannequin, no floating body parts.
ONLY ONE long fluffy curved cat tail, golden cream base blending to orange then deep burgundy-red tip, faithful to source. Arrange in one elegant arc with full length visible. Match source fur tuft shape. No character, hand, clothing, base plug or extra tails.
